# Royal Velvet

Royal Velvet supplies light and dark colour schemes with syntax highlighting tuned for programming. Emoji in headings are given correct colouring, which the description records as requiring Dynamic Highlights, and the inline document title colour is adjustable through Style Settings.

![Royal Velvet screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/caro401/royal-velvet/HEAD/royal-velvet.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Royal Velvet"
    author: "caro401"
    repo:   "caro401/royal-velvet"
    slug:   "royal-velvet"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/royal-velvet"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/caro401/royal-velvet"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/caro401/royal-velvet/HEAD/royal-velvet.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a Royal Velvet–inspired light and dark color scheme with syntax highlighting tuned for programming themes. Display emoji in headings with correct coloring (requires Dynamic Highlights). Customize inline document title color using Style Settings."
}
```
